persona.name: dumper
persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Make an 8-second widescreen video of a paper boat drifting slowly across a pond, fixed camera, soft morning light. Silent, no text.
bank.Which section to retain: Keep the first five seconds of the existing eight-second clip; remove only the final three seconds.
bank.Playback speed and transitions: Keep the original playback speed. Do not add fades or transitions.
bank.Visual style: Natural-looking pond scene in soft morning light; other details are your call.

messages.text: Could you make a video of a paper boat drifting slowly across a pond? I’ve had a busy week, and the idea of watching something that simple feels really calming. I mean an 8-second widescreen video, with the camera fixed in place the whole time. The scene should have soft morning light. Please keep it silent, with no text.
